verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo lockup and the photo strip intact, but crams everything into the top quarter. The lockup is small, the photo is a squashed sliver, and roughly 70% of the canvas below is empty navy with only a stray dot cluster in it. B stacks the lockup large at the bottom, so it fills the tall format and reads well. But its dot-grid decorations are blown up into huge, blurry, pixelated arrow and star shapes that dominate the top. The photo has shrunk to a nearly invisible dash, so the key imagery is lost. Both are broken; B is slightly less bad because the brand is prominent and the space is used.
